plan.morning: Depart the US (international flight — times unconfirmed).
plan.afternoon: On the plane: switch to Thai time (UTC+7) and sleep on Bangkok's schedule.
plan.evening: Pack check (carry-on): passport + photocopy, cards, ~$100 USD to exchange, chargers, dive cert paperwork/eLearning record.

plan.afternoon: In transit. Screenshot the airport hotel address in Thai.
plan.evening: Airport hotel must be booked for TONIGHT (night of Nov 23) — you land ~12:20 AM Nov 24.

plan.morning: You: sleep in at the airport hotel; late checkout (~noon). Your friend lands ~noon (airport + exact time TBC).
plan.afternoon: Meet him in arrivals (allow ~1 h for immigration + bags). Fly together Bangkok → Chiang Mai on a late-afternoon flight (~1 h 15 m), leaving at least 3 h after his landing. Check into the Old City room (4 nights).
plan.evening: YI PENG night 1 (events reported Nov 24–26) — a later evening once you've landed: Tha Phae Gate, lantern-lit Old City lanes, Wat Phan Tao's lantern display. Expect crowds — keep phone + cash in a front pocket.

plan.morning: Easy start. Wat Phra That Doi Suthep (Grab/red truck up ~8 AM), then walk the MONK'S TRAIL down to Wat Pha Lat (~1 h, steep).
plan.afternoon: Wat Chedi Luang + Wat Phra Singh. Wat Chedi Luang has daytime Monk Chat tables (drop-in — check hours).
plan.evening: LOY KRATHONG night (Nov 25 per most sources): reported Tha Phae Gate opening ceremony ~6 PM; buy a krathong and float it on the Ping River near Nawarat Bridge.

days.foodHint: Thai cooking class (half-day, with a market tour).

plan.morning: Thai cooking class (half-day, with a market tour).
plan.afternoon: MUAY THAI beginner class at a Chiang Mai gym (drop-in, ~1.5 h).
plan.evening: Reported: krathong floating on the Ping River (in front of the Municipality Office) 7–10 PM with fireworks ~7:30 and 9:30 PM.

plan.morning: Early pickup (~7 AM) for the CHIANG RAI temples group tour (~12 h; ~3–3.5 h drive each way).
plan.afternoon: WHITE TEMPLE (Wat Rong Khun; fee reportedly 200 THB / ~$6 — check if included) → BLUE TEMPLE (Wat Rong Suea Ten) → usually the Black House.
plan.evening: Back in Chiang Mai ~7–8 PM. Pack a small overnight bag; leave the big bag with the hotel for tomorrow night.

plan.morning: Driver picks up at the Old City hotel ~7 AM → ~1.5–2 h to Doi Inthanon National Park (entry 300 THB / ~$9).
plan.afternoon: Mae Klang Waterfall → Borichinda Cave (km 8.5; ~1.5–2 km walk in) → Wachirathan Waterfall. Optional: Pha Dok Siew trail / rice terraces.
plan.evening: Karen homestay in Mae Klang Luang (book ahead — no walk-ins). Home-cooked dinner; early night.

days.foodHint: SUNDAY WALKING STREET — Ratchadamnoen Rd from Tha Phae Gate, ~4–10:30 PM.

plan.morning: Pre-dawn drive to the summit (2,565 m — very cold). Kew Mae Pan ridge trail (Nov–May; local guide required, ~200 THB / ~$6; ~2–3 h).
plan.afternoon: Twin Royal Pagodas (100 THB / ~$3). Drive back via Wat Phra That Doi Kham. Back to the Chiang Mai hotel (2 nights).
plan.evening: SUNDAY WALKING STREET — Ratchadamnoen Rd from Tha Phae Gate, ~4–10:30 PM.

plan.morning: Free morning. Sleep in, or: Sticky Waterfall (Bua Tong, ~1 h north — you can climb up the falls), or a Thai massage + Nimman cafés.
plan.afternoon: Wat Umong (forest temple with meditation tunnels, near Wat Suan Dok). Pack for the beach.
plan.evening: MONK CHAT at Wat Suan Dok, 5–7 PM (Mon/Wed/Fri per a Mar 2026 listing — confirm): informal Q&A with monks about Buddhism, meditation and monastic life. Dress modestly. Early night — 4:45 AM alarm for the flight.

plan.morning: 6:35 AM flight Chiang Mai → Krabi (FD3070 per timetable sites — confirm it runs Dec 1) → land ~8:30 → private car to Koh Lanta (~2–3 h).
plan.afternoon: ~Noon: Lanta Diver in Saladan (on the way in) — sign up both of you, gear fitting, medical forms, PADI pool session this afternoon (theory done at home via eLearning). Check in on Long Beach (5 nights).
plan.evening: Long Beach sunset. Early night — boat day tomorrow.

days.foodHint: Lanta Old Town or beach seafood.

plan.morning: PADI boat day 1 — open-water dives 1 & 2 (max 12 m) at Koh Haa, Koh Bida or Koh Rok. West-coast hotel pickup.
plan.afternoon: Back mid-afternoon; logbook + skills review. Marine park fee 600 THB (~$18) per person per boat day.
plan.evening: Lanta Old Town or beach seafood. Early night.

plan.morning: PADI boat day 2 — open-water dives 3 & 4 (max 18 m) + final skills.
plan.evening: Celebrate — Long Beach / Klong Khong bars.

plan.morning: FREE DAY 1 — first dives as certified buddies: a fun-dive boat trip (Koh Haa / Koh Rok), or a Koh Rok snorkel day trip.
plan.evening: Optional: evening Muay Thai class at a Lanta gym. Or a sunset bar on Long Beach.

days.foodHint: Last Lanta night — beach seafood dinner.

plan.morning: FREE DAY 2 — island day. Rent a scooter or hire a tuk-tuk: Lanta Old Town on the east coast, then Mu Ko Lanta National Park at the southern tip (lighthouse viewpoint). Sat Dec 5 = Father's Day public holiday — expect it busier.
plan.afternoon: Back for a swim. No diving today keeps the 18-hour no-fly rule easy before tomorrow's flight.
plan.evening: Last Lanta night — beach seafood dinner. Pack.

days.foodHint: CHINATOWN (Yaowarat) street-food crawl — a small-group food tour, or DIY on Yaowarat Rd.

plan.morning: Slow morning on the beach. ~10 AM shared van or car to Krabi Airport (2–3 h).
plan.afternoon: Afternoon flight Krabi → Bangkok (DMK or BKK both fine). Check into the Bangkok hotel (2 nights; riverside or Silom/Sathorn).
plan.evening: CHINATOWN (Yaowarat) street-food crawl — a small-group food tour, or DIY on Yaowarat Rd.

plan.morning: GRAND PALACE (opens ~8:30 AM; strict dress code) → WAT PHO (reclining Buddha; massage school on site).
plan.afternoon: Ferry across to WAT ARUN; longtail boat through the Thonburi canals.
plan.evening: LIVE MUAY THAI at Rajadamnern Stadium (check the December card — nights vary). Note: Mon Dec 7 may be the substitute Father's Day holiday.

plan.morning: Sleep in; ask for late checkout (or a day-use room to shower before the flight).
plan.afternoon: Last massage, MBK or a mall run; spend or exchange leftover baht.
plan.evening: Leave for Suvarnabhumi (BKK) by ~7:30 PM — international flight departs 11:15 PM (times unconfirmed). Arrive 3 h early.
